verdict.rationale: uv's own docs claim support for 'Cargo-style workspaces for scalable projects' and describe uv.lock as a cross-platform lockfile, so the core monorepo-workspace capability is a documented first-party feature. The evidence is only a one-line homepage claim, though; it never shows workspace members sharing a single lockfile or local packages depending on each other. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that workspace members share one uv.lock, evidence of cross-linked local (path/workspace) dependencies between members, workspace configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration of monorepo use.
